text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Mejiro Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She stood motionless in front of the crane game.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um... I was just remembering a scene from a book I read before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There's this girl struggling to get a plushie from the claw crane game, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A dashing boyfriend swoops in, effortlessly
wins a plushie, and presents it to her as a gift!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've always admired that scene so much...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what am I even saying?
Please forget that, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um... as long as you can take it for me,
any of them... is fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!
